solver_notes: Standalone native aarch64 C11/pthreads regression model for the stated CPython lifecycle invariant, not a claimed patch to CPython and not a claim that Python/pylifecycle.c belongs to torvalds/linux. The buggy lane deterministically deletes and munmaps an unpinned tstate between the daemon SaveThread pointer read and dereference; the kernel returns SIGSEGV (shell exit 139). The fixed lane acquires head_mutex for both SaveThread pinning and interpreter unlink/deletion, takes a temporary atomic tstate reference before releasing the mutex, and drops references with acquire-release atomic decrements (2->1->0). Twenty fixed-lane repetitions plus the declared pytest gates pass. ASan was attempted first but its allocator initialization failed on this host before test execution; that environmental failure is retained as asan_allocator_failure.log and is not used as evidence.
